summary: Revised the boundary experiment for the replay-completion question to measure its central quantitative claim at a second batch size. Alongside the existing 16-batch pair the harness now places the replay on both sides of the FSM channel's capacity at the library default of 64 batches: staged commit indices 8193 and 8194 deliver 8192 and 8193 tuples, that is exactly 128 and 129 delivered batches. Four admissions and four comparisons encode the pairs (each restart must return; the 128-batch cases are expected to hold and the 129-batch cases to be violated), the earlier pair unchanged apart from its case names carrying the batch size, with previous_id 3bdf46ca8b274b719cc26e672b951e75-experiment and the reason recorded. Local construction feedback reproduced both boundaries: at 16 batches, 2049 returned in 0ms and 2050 did not return; at 64 batches, 8193 delivered 8192 tuples in 128 batches and returned in 2ms, while 8194 delivered 8193 tuples in 129 batches and did not return with two stack samples. The retained receipt is requested, and folding it into the account remains for the next turn if the run allows.
